topology: VLAN 10 has PC1 192.168.10.10 on SW1 Gi0/1 for filtering tests, unaffected PC2 .20 on Gi0/2, HTTP/ping SRV1 .100 on Gi0/3, and PC3 .30 on Gi0/4 for shutdown and recovery tests. Access VLANs, PortFast and /24 host addresses are prepared; no router is required.
verificationNotes: Practice has zero earned tasks and accepts a real unprotected traffic burst. Published IOS commands or the completed reference earn five configuration goals. Three real class-specific suppressions, a PC1 server ping, real PC3 shutdown, a PC2 server ping during isolation and a PC3 ping after automatic recovery complete all twelve.

Gi0/1 uses 0.10/0.05-percent rising/falling thresholds for broadcast, multicast and unknown-unicast with default filtering. Gi0/4 uses those broadcast thresholds with shutdown action. Storm-control detection and a 30-second recovery timer are enabled globally. These low thresholds are teaching values, not production recommendations.

Guide instruments schedule at most 256 real 1500-byte UDP/IP packets two milliseconds apart over the real Ethernet path, with source validation, concurrent-run protection and generation checks. Packet serialization, VLAN forwarding, policy meters and delivery are exercised normally. No counters or task completion flags are injected. A shutdown interrupts the source before all frames are sent.

Broadcast, multicast and documentation-destination unknown-unicast bursts have explicit Ethernet destinations. Some packets pass before a threshold is crossed. Drop telemetry records actual class, port, source identity, measured percentage and packet ID; unrelated counters and events cannot fabricate proof. At most 1000 decision rows are retained.

Focused tests cover 100-percent bypass, removed classifiers, zero-percent suppression, invalid thresholds, idle recovery, wrong shutdown action, manual versus automatic recovery, source cancellation, missing recovery configuration, telemetry bounds and preserved saved observations. Learned-unicast traffic continues during unknown-unicast suppression; expired destination entries are treated as unknown.

The no storm-control action shutdown and no storm-control action trap forms now restore default filtering for the named active action, preserving thresholds. They do not inadvertently enable traps. Existing action trap logging is outside the lab requirements; SNMP trap delivery and bps/pps syntax are not claimed.

PC2 connectivity proof requires real correlated echo request/reply packets while the affected port is currently storm-control err-disabled. The PC3 recovery task requires the actual engine timer event and later real replies; manual shutdown/no shutdown is insufficient.

Configuration and earned packet observations survive portable reopening. The completed reference contains no fabricated runtime evidence. Both practice and completed modes are exercised through the browser in all six theme/viewport combinations.
